notes.title: Steam Demo Update - Q&A
notes.content:
Hello, hope you enjoy this small update, focused on polishing the game.

New - Tutorial
New - Key binding menu!!
Language and Screen resolution bug fixing
General improvements and slight game balancing

notes.title: Shape Shipter Demo Update
notes.content:
In this update I've added a little bit of content, some polish, enemy animations and balancing, hope you enjoy it! :D
Important: this version will reset your progress.


The max wave is now 25, can you completed?
Slightly tweak the XP required for each star star level
Added more upgrades to the Rewards Track
Phase Canyon will no longer randomly change target
